events.description: Looking at the roasted bananas in the oven and walking around the kitchen.
Scraping roasted bananas from the skillet into the blender.
Walking to the oven to retrieve another baking pan of roasted bananas.
Scraping roasted bananas from the baking pan into the blender jar.
Taking the empty baking pan to the sink and placing it inside.
Plugging in the blender, securing the lid, and blending the bananas.
Preparing the ice cream maker by inserting the paddle.
Juicing a lemon and squeezing the juice into the blender jar.
Stirring the mixture, putting the lid on the blender, and blending it again.
Pouring and scraping the blended banana mixture into the ice cream maker bowl.
Plugging in the ice cream maker and closing the oven door.
Setting the timer on the ice cream maker.
Adjusting the paddle, inserting the bowl, and putting the lid on the ice cream maker.
Watching the ice cream maker churn and wiping down its exterior.
Consulting the recipe book and laying out ingredients on the counter.
